method: Independent manual visual inspection of stable, finished actual Playmode PNG files using view_image; read-only source and serialized-prefab geometry review. No UI control or image editing.

observations.details: The large ferry-court building is recognizable in both early stages. Closed is darker, enclosed and has visible salvage; Growing is lighter with readable fencing, crates and a workbench. The earlier nearly empty early-stage presentation remains corrected.

The boat-repair workshop and open classroom with benches and river maps have clear, different silhouettes. The former roof-walker artifact is absent; architecture correctly occludes actors moving behind it. Transparent art boundaries show no atlas-background bleed.

Mary house is fully visible at zoom48, separated by a broad clear gap from the residential blocks across the village walk. It stands in its own river courtyard, with both adjacent paths and the turquoise river visible. The reading corner is identifiable to the right of the Rowan. The Rowan canopy covers only a small portion of the lower platform, not the entrance or facade. No new visible blocker was observed in this completed Mary image.
Lanterns, open seating and the distinct pavilion are recognizable. Foreground shops and vegetation partly screen the lower-left area with normal isometric depth ordering.
Russian title, objective, close control and both action buttons fit and are legible.
French identity, chapter, goal rows and both branch buttons fit and remain readable. Longer history reaches the existing viewport mask; manual scrolling was not exercised.

limits: This is independent manual inspection of exactly nine freshly written PNGs, identified by hashes and UTC write times. It is not manual review of every83-image capture.

The completed Mary image shows its reading corner and Rowan. The Mary growing workbench and early Mary fence stages are inactive there and are not separately captured in the nine-image sample; saved coordinates and geometry have separate asset-test evidence.
Capture completion is recorded only when the run-specific completion JSON exists. An earlier passed capture receipt is not reused to claim this run passed.
No manual scroll interaction, physical-device touch, audio check, human story playthrough or direct user visual acceptance was performed.

historicalPartialReview.earlierStageObservation: Closed salvage and growing materials were too small; superseded by the current large, identifiable early-stage images.

resolvedVisualIssues.evidence: Large recognizable architecture, fencing and restoration material replace the earlier empty-looking stages.
Own architecture ground anchors correctly occlude walking actors behind the roof.
The complete Mary house is visible at zoom48.
The house is visibly separate from the neighboring residential blocks in its independent river courtyard.

maryCourtyardGeometryChecked.fenceShape: Diamond with |dx|+|dy|<=16, not a filled32x32 rectangle. Left tip x111 touches the existing walk edge; the path center x108 stays clear. Warning-post artwork may slightly cover the path edge.
maryCourtyardGeometryChecked.notes: The installed courtyard moves the whole Mary project and moves the two large exterior props inward. The completed actual GameView shows an independent house with free adjacent paths and a visible river. Rowan canopy partly screens the lower platform without obscuring entry/facade. The growing Mary workbench and closed/growing Mary fence are not separately shown in these nine images; their coordinates, fitted geometry and saved bindings were checked through read-only geometry and root-run reloaded asset tests.
